title: Gemini Deep Think Derives Exact Cosmic-String Gravitational Radiation Integrals and Settles Open TCS Conjectures
aiSystem: Gemini Deep Think + Tree Search & Numerical Verification (Google DeepMind)
whyItMatters: Collaborating with David Woodruff and physicists, Gemini Deep Think derived six exact analytical Gegenbauer-polynomial solutions for cosmic-string gravitational radiation and settled a decade-old online submodular optimization conjecture.
summary: In companion February–March 2026 papers (arXiv:2602.03837 led by David P. Woodruff et al., and arXiv:2603.04735), Google DeepMind and academic collaborators documented a suite of original research breakthroughs produced with Gemini Deep Think across theoretical physics, computer science, information theory, and mechanism design. In theoretical physics, a neuro-symbolic Gemini Deep Think + tree-search agent derived six novel exact analytical evaluations—most elegantly via Gegenbauer polynomial expansions absorbing integrand singularities—for the gravitational-wave power spectrum integral I(N, α) of cosmic-string loops. In theoretical CS, Gemini broke deadlocks on Max-Cut and high-dimensional Steiner Tree bounds, settled a 10-year conjecture in online submodular optimization, and extended auction Revelation Principles from rational to real bids, with multiple results accepted at top venues including ICLR 2026.
technicalHighlights: Derived six novel exact analytical methods (highlighting Gegenbauer polynomials) solving singular cosmic-string gravitational-wave radiation integrals for arbitrary loop geometries.
Settled a 10-year-old conjecture in online submodular optimization and broke deadlocks on classic Max-Cut and Steiner Tree problems.
Demonstrated cross-disciplinary human–AI collaboration spanning physics, cryptography, economics, and complexity theory, including peer-reviewed conference acceptances.
caveats: Case studies were produced under expert human guidance and problem selection; several individual results are distributed across follow-up conference and journal submissions.

scoreRationale.foundational: Produced multiple genuine analytical breakthroughs in both theoretical astrophysics (cosmic-string integrals) and theoretical computer science.
scoreRationale.ripple: Demonstrated that reasoning LLMs generalize well beyond pure math competitions into open-ended physics derivations and TCS proofs.
scoreRationale.verification: Verified analytically, numerically, and through peer-reviewed academic submissions including ICLR 2026.
scoreRationale.velocity: Synthesized cross-field mathematical techniques (e.g., Gegenbauer expansions connecting to QFT Feynman parameters) rapidly under guided tree search.
